Invoke-FailureModeAnalysis.ps1.Description: Timestamped active-host session error catalog with read-only lifecycle diagnostics and recent workspace actions.

Show-FailureAnalysis.ps1.Description: Opens a retained failure-analysis snapshot through the local LCM daemon without rerunning analysis.

Invoke-LcmDisplayRender.ps1.Description: Internal allowlisted renderer for verified Standard Display publication; not a user-facing display launcher.

Test-MacriumCurrentBaseline.ps1.Description: Read-only plausibility and snapshot-evidence check for the current F:-I: Macrium BCR baseline.

Dismount-MacriumCurrentBaseline.ps1.Description: Explicitly detaches only the label-matched F:-I: Macrium BCR baseline after confirmation.

Mount-MacriumLatestBaseline.ps1.Description: Explicitly mounts the latest completed same-day Macrium image through the canonical baseline workflow.
